name: IBI Investment House
verdict: Israeli investment house listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (IBI Investment House Ltd). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Main sponsor of Hapoel Tel Aviv B.C. — the team plays as Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv and carries IBI across the front of the 2026/27 home jersey. IBI is IBI Investment House Ltd, a public company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (ibi-ownership); no state or state fund in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found (checked 2026-10-01). A 2025 financial enforcement fine from Israel's securities authority over crypto-related withdrawals (Ice, ice.co.il) is a financial record, which doesn't count under METHOD.md. Rated none.
